title: Goldfish waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd166'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#f4a300'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d97e00'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tailGrad' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='100%' y2='100%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb347'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ef7d00'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='finGrad' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='0%' y2='100%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffc266'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e88000'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M30 52 C18 38 12 28 16 22 C20 28 26 34 32 40 C26 30 24 20 28 16 C32 26 34 36 36 44 Z' fill='url(#tailGrad)'/>
  <path d='M30 56 C18 68 12 76 16 82 C20 76 26 70 32 64 C26 72 24 82 28 86 C32 76 34 66 36 58 Z' fill='url(#tailGrad)'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='51' rx='28' ry='21' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='60' rx='17' ry='9' fill='#ffe08a' opacity='0.75'/>

  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <path d='M48 31 C52 18 62 16 68 22 C62 24 58 28 56 33 Z' fill='url(#finGrad)'/>

  <!-- waving pectoral fin -->
  <g>
    <path d='M68 58 C74 66 72 76 66 82 C64 76 62 68 60 61 Z' fill='url(#finGrad)'/>
    <path d='M66 82 C70 84 74 82 76 78' stroke='#e88000' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  </g>

  <!-- pelvic fin -->
  <path d='M52 70 C54 76 58 79 63 79 C59 74 57 71 56 68 Z' fill='url(#finGrad)'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='45' r='6' fill='#fff6d8'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='45' r='3.4' fill='#3a2a00'/>
  <circle cx='72.2' cy='43.8' r='1.1' fill='#fffbe8'/>

  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='54' r='3' fill='#ff8a65' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M80 51 Q76 55 80 57' stroke='#c96a00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>

  <!-- scales details -->
  <g stroke='#e07a00' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' opacity='0.55' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <path d='M46 44 q4 3 0 7'/>
    <path d='M52 40 q4 3 0 7'/>
    <path d='M46 54 q4 3 0 7'/>
    <path d='M52 50 q4 3 0 7'/>
    <path d='M58 46 q4 3 0 7'/>
  </g>

  <!-- little bubbles -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='34' r='2.6' fill='#a8e6ff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='27' r='1.8' fill='#a8e6ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='87' cy='20' r='1.3' fill='#a8e6ff' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
